scholarships.name: Study Visits for Academics - Artists and Architects **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: The aim of this programme is to promote artistic cooperations with German host institutions. The scholarships are funded by the German Federal Foreign Office.
scholarships.deadlineText: Application deadlines are updated annually in the second quarter. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here:
scholarships.sourceQuote: University teachers from the following disciplines are eligible to apply: Architecture (Interior Design, Monument Conservation, Urban Planning/Urban Development, Regional Planning, Landscape Architecture, Landscape Planning) Fine Art, Film, Design, Visual Communication Performing Arts (Drama, Direction, Musicals, Dance, Performance Studies, Choreography, etc.) Music

eligibility.sourceQuote: University teachers from the following disciplines are eligible to apply:

eligibility.textValue: teach at an institute of higher education in your home country
eligibility.sourceQuote: You must teach at an institute of higher education in your home country.

eligibility.textValue: research project coordinated with the cooperation partner in Germany
eligibility.sourceQuote: The research project must be coordinated with the cooperation partner in Germany.
